title: Create Discovery Config
description: Creates a new discovery configuration for data profiling.

objective.narrative: A discovery configuration defines how Cloud DLP scans and profiles data in your Google Cloud environment. This sample creates a configuration that profiles all BigQuery tables monthly. The discovery config's ID is dynamically generated on creation.
